title: School Uniform 솔로 #018 · BBW bombshell · 마이크로 탑 × 마이크로 + 리본 보우 + 자두색 · modal jersey · 머리 넘기기 · 대형 도서관 · 강남언니
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, sculpted updo chestnut brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a micro top of two small oval patches of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey held by thin straps over her shoulders and joined at the center by a small plum satin ribbon bow, her shoulders, arms and midriff bare, and a micro pleated skirt of ultra-thin matte plum modal jersey with a thin white stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark near her lips and faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the crisp pleats of the skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: one hand sweeping her hair back, the other resting on her hip, one leg crossed in front to show the boot — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy plum leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her whole hand, in plum lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips.

Background: a grand old library hall with a pale marble floor, tall bookshelves, a spiral stair with a waist-high rail and a standard-height doorway, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
